ImageDescription.value: In 1965, Khochhen Rinpoche and small group of monks began the process of re-establishing Mindrolling monastery based on the original one in Tibet, near Clement Town, in Dehradun, Uttarakhand state, India. It now contains Ngagyur Nyingma College, one of the largest Buddhist institutes in India. The front view of the Buddha's descent from devaloka
